responsibility: Defines the CIS-owned Layer-2 execution contract, single-use capability token, closed adapter enforcement vocabulary, a provider-neutral ExecutionBudget vocabulary that this unit declares but neither terminates nor meters itself, and an immutable, optional ExecutionUsage vocabulary a backend may report measured usage through without changing the identity of a result that carries none.
reads: the execution request handed to it
failure_boundary: fail_closed — a request with no opaque issued capability, a capability issued for different content, or a spent capability is refused before any backend work begins
recovery_behavior: Outstanding capabilities are process-local and single-use; interruption invalidates or spends them, while durable recovery requires a new execution authorization rather than token replay
replacement_contract: A replacement must keep the request shape free of backend-specific fields, issue an unpredictable single-use capability bound server-side to the authorization binding and exact request (including any attached budget), keep run-specific attestation outside the deterministic result hash, declare capabilities rather than infer them, explicitly declare whether frozen task-contract and execution-input authority are required, expose immutable execution-image, trusted-runner and worker identities when execution input is required, enumerate the policy prohibitions, checks and evidence labels it can deterministically satisfy, and declare a closed set of budget dimensions (wall_time_ms, token_limit, cost_limit_micros) it actually enforces, defaulting to none. Declaring a budget on a request binds it into the request hash and capability; it does not, by itself, cause any adapter to meter or terminate on it — only an adapter's own enforced_budget_dimensions declaration does that, and this unit defines the vocabulary only, never the metering or termination itself. A backend may optionally report immutable, nonnegative ExecutionUsage (wall_time_ms, tokens_used, cost_micros) on its result; a result that carries none hashes and records exactly as it did before this field existed, and measured usage is never folded into the deterministic result hash because it is run-specific, not semantic, by the same rule that already keeps evidence out of it.
evidence_produced: request_hash over the full request contract view, including the attached budget when present
result_hash over the stable semantic result while run-specific evidence remains separately admitted
ExecutionRefused detail when a token does not verify
closed adapter declarations for deterministically enforced policy prohibitions, checks and evidence labels
closed declarations for required frozen contracts, execution-input bindings and immutable execution-image, trusted-runner and worker identities
closed adapter declaration of enforced budget dimensions, defaulting to none

six typed ExecutionRefused subclasses naming timeout, budget exhaustion, permission wait, provider failure, incomplete output and invalid artifact as distinct, specific failure modes — vocabulary only, not raised by this module
optional, immutable ExecutionUsage on a result, present only when a backend actually reports measured wall time, tokens and cost
